request.cross_origin: The request came from another origin and was refused.

internal: The command failed unexpectedly; see the log.

auth.plex_only: This account signs in with Plex: it has no password here.
auth.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts; try again later.
auth.access_disabled: This account's access is cut: an Admin gives it back in Accounts.

right.missing: The account's role lacks the right this needs.
right.unknown: A right named is not one the server knows.

instance.read_only: This instance is read-only: nothing was changed.
instance.forbidden_write: This instance forbids this change: nothing was changed.

account.unknown: No account has the e-mail given as EMAIL.
account.email_invalid: An account needs a name and a valid e-mail.
account.email_taken: An account already has this e-mail.
account.admin_untouchable: Only an Admin changes an Admin account or gives the Admin role.
account.last_admin: No account would be left on the Admin role: nothing was changed.
account.access_admin_only: Only an Admin cuts or gives back an account's access.
account.owner_access: The server owner's access is never cut.
account.own_access: An Admin cannot cut their own access.
account.admin_owner_only: Only the server's owner gives the Admin role.
account.owner_admin: The server owner's account never leaves the Admin role.

media.not_found: No media answers this provider id.
media.ambiguous: Several library rows or folders hold this provider id: settle the duplicate before deleting; nothing was deleted.

provider.unavailable: A metadata provider did not answer; try again later.

library.locked: The pipeline holds the library: try again when the run ends; nothing was deleted.
library.obligations_unreadable: The seeding obligations cannot be read: nothing was deleted while what a tracker is still owed is unknown.
library.unavailable: The library index (library.db) is unreadable or absent; nothing was read or changed.

role.system_immutable: The Admin role cannot be changed.
role.own_role: A manager who is not Admin cannot change their own role.
role.escalation: The role would give rights your own role lacks.
role.name_taken: Another role already has this name.
role.in_use: An account holds this role: it cannot be deleted.
role.default: New accounts start on this role: it cannot be deleted.

password.required: A local account needs a password.
password.too_short: The password needs at least {{minimum}} characters, including an uppercase letter, a digit and a special character.
password.current_wrong: The current password is wrong: nothing was changed.
password.held_by_cli: The server owner's fallback password is changed with "accounts set-password" on the server only.
password.reset_admin_only: Only an Admin resets a password; change your own from your profile.
password.too_weak: The password needs at least {{minimum}} characters, including an uppercase letter, a digit and a special character: one of them is missing.
password.reset_own: An Admin changes their own password from their profile, with the current one.

plex.unreachable: plex.tv did not answer; try again later.
plex.server_unreachable: The Plex server did not answer; try again later.
plex.token_refused: plex.tv refused the sign-in; start it again.
plex.pin_unknown: No Plex sign-in started in this browser answers this request; start it again.
plex.pin_expired: The Plex sign-in expired; start it again.
